steps.analyst_reply: {"root_cause": "The scorecard relies on a single holistic question, and it fails in two systematic ways. First, it misses explicit surgical evidence (one bio says 'board certified in Surgery' yet was called physician; others name orthopaedic centers, thoracic surgery degrees, or vascular practices) when that evidence is buried in boilerplate about insurance and residencies. Second, it over-fires on the bare word 'surgery' when the person is a physician extender ('Mr./Ms. X practices medicine and specializes in Hand/Urological Surgery') or in a non-core field (refractive/eye surgery, pelvic reconstructive surgery), all of which are labeled physician in this data.
